panels.title: Net Weight per Crossing Over Time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_time2 AS time, ticket_type AS metric, net_weight AS value
        FROM tickets
        WHERE site IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND voyage IN (${voyage:sqlstring}) AND ticket_type IN (${ticket_type:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(date_time2)
        ORDER BY date_time2

SELECT date_time2 AS time, ticket_type AS metric,
               SUM(net_weight) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_type ORDER BY date_time2) AS value
        FROM tickets
        WHERE site IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND voyage IN (${voyage:sqlstring}) AND ticket_type IN (${ticket_type:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(date_time2)
        ORDER BY date_time2

SELECT site AS metric, SUM(net_weight) AS value

panels.title: Net Weight & Cycle Time per Tip, by Truck — Top 15

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_time2 AS time,
                        vehicle_num || ' - weight (t)' AS metric,
                        net_weight AS value
                 FROM tickets
                 WHERE site IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND voyage IN (${voyage:sqlstring}) AND ticket_type IN (${ticket_type:sqlstring}) AND vehicle_num IN (
    SELECT vehicle_num FROM tickets
    WHERE site IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND voyage IN (${voyage:sqlstring}) AND ticket_type IN (${ticket_type:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY vehicle_num
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 15
)
                       AND $__timeFilter(date_time2)
                 ORDER BY date_time2

SELECT date_time2 AS time,
                         vehicle_num || ' - cycle (min)' AS metric,
                         cycle_seconds/60.0 AS value
                  FROM tickets
                  WHERE site IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND voyage IN (${voyage:sqlstring}) AND ticket_type IN (${ticket_type:sqlstring}) AND vehicle_num IN (
    SELECT vehicle_num FROM tickets
    WHERE site IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND voyage IN (${voyage:sqlstring}) AND ticket_type IN (${ticket_type:sqlstring})
    GROUP BY vehicle_num
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 15
)
                        AND $__timeFilter(date_time2)
                  ORDER BY date_time2

SELECT site, ticket, vehicle_num, voyage, ticket_type, date_time, date_time2,
               weight1, weight2, net_weight,
               ROUND((cycle_seconds/60.0)::numeric, 1) AS cycle_minutes,
               ROUND(weight_mismatch::numeric, 2) AS weight_mismatch,
               cycle_time_reversed
        FROM tickets
        WHERE site IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND voyage IN (${voyage:sqlstring}) AND ticket_type IN (${ticket_type:sqlstring})
          AND (
                weight_mismatch > 0.01
             OR cycle_seconds > 1800
             OR net_weight < 10
             OR cycle_time_reversed
          )
        ORDER BY date_time
